topic: Qwen3.8-27B overthinks coding tasks: the knobs that cut the waste
title: Qwen3.8-27B overthinks your code: the fix
description: Working value; the package stage overwrites.
narration_full: Twenty-one minutes for one SVG. You run this model locally for coding. So: slow model. Same weights, medium effort: seventy-seven seconds a question, same typical score. Qwen three point eight twenty-seven B gives thinking three stops: low, medium, xhigh. The chat template, the formatter behind every request, hands you the maximum when you set nothing. Generous. Set reasoning effort, the thinking-depth dial, to medium. Engines can ignore that, so add a hard cap: two thousand forty-eight thinking tokens. Dwim, a local coding agent, resolved sixty-four percent of issues against fifty-two percent. xhigh keeps the higher ceiling, and Qwen warns agent retries can eat the savings. You never bought a slow model; the dial shipped glued.
